```{r preparation_for_clustGLMM, echo=TRUE}
# splines
degree <- 2
knots <- c(-3, -1, 1, 3, 5.5)
inner <- knots[-c(1, length(knots))]
bound <- knots[c(1, length(knots))]
splB <- bs(macs$Time, knots = inner, Boundary.knots = bound, 
           degree = degree, intercept = FALSE)
spldim <- dim(splB)[2]
bsnames_Time <- paste0("bs_Time",1:spldim)
macs[,bsnames_Time] <- splB

# outcomes and regressors to be used
family <- c("num", "num", "bin", "ord", "ord") 
names(family) <- Ys <- c("CD4", "cesd", "drug", "fcigpacks", "fsexpartners")

id <- "ID"
formula <- list()
for(y in Ys){
  # formula = group-specific spline curves
  formula[[y]] <- list()
  formula[[y]]$fixed <- as.formula("~ 1")
  formula[[y]]$group <- as.formula(paste0("~ ", paste(bsnames_Time, collapse = " + ")))
  formula[[y]]$random <- as.formula("~ 1")
  formula[[y]]$offset <- ""
}

# Group-specificity of other model parameters
varying <- default_varying()
save <- default_save()
param <- default_param()
param["sd_beta_num"] <- 1000
```

```{r mcmc, message=FALSE, echo=TRUE, results=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
iter = 100
set.seed(12345)
mcmc <- clustGLMM(formula = formula, id = id, family = family, data = macs,
                  G = 2, varying = varying, save = save, param = param,
                  iter = iter, nchains = 3, howsave = "matrix")

# preserve the interpretation of cluster labels by permuting cluster-specific parameters
perm <- list()
perm[[1]] <- c(1, 2) 
perm[[2]] <- c(2, 1) 
perm[[3]] <- c(1, 2) 
mcmc <- PermuteClusterSpec(mcmc, perm)
```


```{r mcmc_summary, message=FALSE, echo=TRUE, results=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
mcmc
summary(mcmc)
plot(mcmc, chains=1:3)
ch <- 1
burnin <- 10
thin <- 1
plot(mcmc, "beta_num", burnin=burnin, thin=thin, chains=ch)
plot(mcmc, "beta_num", which="clusters_kerneldensity", burnin=burnin, thin=thin, chains=ch)
plot(mcmc, "prec_num", which="clusters_kerneldensity", burnin=burnin, thin=thin, chains=ch)

plot(mcmc, "beta_bin", burnin=burnin, thin=thin, chains=ch)
plot(mcmc, "beta_bin", which="clusters_kerneldensity", burnin=burnin, thin=thin, chains=ch)

plot(mcmc, "beta_ord", burnin=burnin, thin=thin, chains=ch)
plot(mcmc, "beta_ord", which="clusters_kerneldensity", burnin=burnin, thin=thin, chains=ch)
plot(mcmc, "c_ord", which="clusters_kerneldensity", burnin=burnin, thin=thin, chains=ch)
plot(mcmc, "corSigma", which="kerneldensity", burnin=burnin, thin=thin, chains=ch)
```



```{r clusteringU, echo=TRUE}
clusteringU <- function(mcmc, data, id, threshold = 0.5){
  clusteringU <- mcmc$clustering
  clusteringU[mcmc$certainty < threshold] <- 0
  
  # proposed clustering by each chain separately
  for(ch in 1:mcmc$nchains){
    data[, paste0("clustering", ch)] <- clusteringU[as.character(data[, id]), ch]
    data[, paste0("certainty", ch)] <- mcmc$certainty[as.character(data[, id]), ch]
  }
  
  return(data)
}
```

```{r clusteringU_mcmc, echo=TRUE}
macs <- clusteringU(mcmc, macs, id = id, threshold = 0.5)
macs1 <- macs[match(unique(macs[,id]), macs[,id]),]
table(macs[,paste0("clustering",1)])
table(macs[,paste0("clustering",2)])
table(macs[,paste0("clustering",3)])
```

```{r ynum_vs_Time_clustered, echo=TRUE, results=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
ch <- 1
COL <- rainbow_hcl(mcmc$modeGplus[ch], c = 80, l = 50)
Time_grid <- seq(-3, 5.5, by = 0.1)

par(mfrow=nice_nrow_ncol(length(mcmc$Nums)), mar=c(4,4,1,0.5))
for(y in mcmc$Nums){
  plot_num_vs_x_grouped(macs, y=y, x="Time", g=paste0("clustering",ch), id=id, 
                        legend_placement="topright", add_lowess = FALSE)
  
  newdata <- data.frame(Time = Time_grid)
  newdata[, bsnames_Time] <- bs(Time_grid, knots = inner, Boundary.knots = bound, 
                                degree = degree, intercept = FALSE)
  pred <- predict(mcmc, newdata, y=y, type="lp", what="fg", method="samples",
                  burnin=burnin, thin=thin, chain=ch)
  for(ig in 1:mcmc$modeGplus[ch]){
    g <- mcmc$clusters[[ch]][ig]
    lines(x = Time_grid,
          y = pred$fit[,paste0("(",g,")")],
          col = COL[ig], lwd = 3)
    if(!is.null(pred$lwr)){
      lines(x = Time_grid,
            y = pred$lwr[,paste0("(",g,")")],
            col = COL[ig], lty = 2)
    }
    if(!is.null(pred$upr)){
      lines(x = Time_grid,
            y = pred$upr[,paste0("(",g,")")],
            col = COL[ig], lty = 2)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r ybinord_vs_Time_splines, echo=TRUE, results=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
par(mfrow=nice_nrow_ncol(length(c(mcmc$Bins, mcmc$Ords))), mar=c(4,4,2,0.5))
for(y in c(mcmc$Bins, mcmc$Ords)){
  newdata <- data.frame(Time = Time_grid)
  newdata[, bsnames_Time] <- bs(Time_grid, knots = inner, Boundary.knots = bound, 
                                degree = degree, intercept = FALSE)
  maxk <- ifelse(mcmc$family[y] == "ord", mcmc$Kord[y], 1)
  pred <- list()
  for(k in 1:maxk){
    pred[[k]] <- predict(mcmc, newdata, y=y, type="lp", what="fg", method="samples",
                         k=k,
                         burnin=burnin, thin=thin, chain=ch)
  }
  plot(x=0, y=0, type="n",
       xlim=range(Time_grid), ylim=range(unlist(pred)),
       xlab="Time", ylab=paste0("linear predictor", 
                                ifelse(mcmc$family[y] == "ord",
                                       " - ordered intercept",
                                       "")),
       main=y)
  for(k in 1:maxk){
    for(ig in 1:mcmc$modeGplus[ch]){
      g <- mcmc$clusters[[ch]][ig]
      lines(x = Time_grid,
            y = pred[[k]]$fit[,paste0("(",g,")")],
            col = COL[ig], lwd = 3)
      if(!is.null(pred$lwr) | maxk==1){
        lines(x = Time_grid,
              y = pred[[k]]$lwr[,paste0("(",g,")")],
              col = COL[ig], lty = 2)
      }
      if(!is.null(pred$upr) | maxk==1){
        lines(x = Time_grid,
              y = pred[[k]]$upr[,paste0("(",g,")")],
              col = COL[ig], lty = 2)
      }
    }
  }
}
```
